_comment: Expected buildClientReport() output for client GOLD3, period 2020-04, which has NEITHER claim-level data NOR a monthly_summaries row. This is the NULL-vs-0 assertion the plan calls for: an empty month must produce nulls for every rate/average field, not zeros — the one deliberate exception being arOver90Pct, which is a verbatim-ported quirk from production.py line 199 (0, not null, when openAr is 0).
